name: Visitor Invitation Guest Email
subject: Visitor Pre-Registration Invitation
message:
Dear {{ frappe.utils.escape_html(doc.guest_name or 'Visitor') }},

You have received a visitor pre-registration invitation from our company.
Visitor Type: {{ doc.visitor_type or '-' }}
Host: {{ doc.guest_host or '-' }}
Visit Date: {{ doc.guest_visit_date or '-' }}
Expected Check-In: {{ doc.guest_checkin or '-' }}
Expected Check-Out: {{ doc.guest_checkout or '-' }}
Purpose: {{ doc.purpose_of_visit or '-' }}

Please use the secure link below to fill your information before arrival:
{{ doc.guest_link }}

This invitation expires on {{ doc.guest_expires_on }}.

name: Walk In Host Approval Email
subject: Walk-In Visitor Approval Required: {{ doc.visitor_full_name }}
message:
Dear {{ doc.host_name }},

A walk-in visitor is at the gate and requires your approval:

  • Visitor: {{ doc.visitor_full_name }}
    • {% if doc.also_visiting %}
  • Also visiting: {{ doc.also_visiting }} — each gets their own pass when you approve
    • {% endif %}
  • Total visitors: {{ doc.number_of_visitors or 1 }}
  • Type: {{ doc.visitor_type }}
  • Purpose: {{ doc.purpose_of_visit or '-' }}
  • Mobile: {{ doc.mobile_number or '-' }}
  • Date: {{ doc.visit_date }}
  • Time: {{ doc.visit_time_label }}

Click here to Approve or Reject
